## What the academy does

Master Makeup Studio & Academy trains **professional beauticians**. The Professional Beautician Course is the academy's flagship programme — it does **not** currently offer makeup artistry, hairstyling, nail art, hair floral art, or saree draping as separate tracks.

## Professional Beautician Course — full module list

1. **Skin Science & Analysis** — skin types, conditions, magnifying-lamp analysis, treatment-plan design
2. **Facial Treatments (Basic → Advanced)** — hydrating, anti-ageing, brightening, gold, diamond, fruit facials
3. **Threading & Eyebrow Shaping** — precision threading, brow mapping, full-face threading, aftercare
4. **Waxing & Depilation Techniques** — hot, cold, strip, Rica wax, full-body protocols, post-care
5. **Bleaching & Skin Brightening** — bleach chemistry, face/body/underarm protocols, patch testing
6. **De-Tan Treatments** — sun-tan removal for face, hand, foot, full body
7. **Clean-Up Treatments** — express protocol with steam, extraction, toning
8. **Body Polishing & Scrubs** — full-body exfoliation, formulation, massage sequencing
9. **Body Wraps & Masks** — clay, mud, seaweed, herbal wraps
10. **Manicure & Pedicure** — nail, cuticle, callus care, hand and foot therapy
11. **Eyebrow & Eyelash Enhancement** — tinting, lamination, lash lift, extensions
12. **Product Knowledge & Client Consultation** — brand chemistry, label-reading, consultation craft
13. **Salon Management & Business Skills** — booking, hygiene, billing, social-media, pricing
14. **Hygiene, Safety & Sterilisation** — sanitation protocols, infection control
15. **Practical Training & Assessment** — live-client sessions, mock exams, written + practical pass

## Course details

- **Duration**: 3 months (Mon–Sat, morning or evening batch)
- **Fast-track option**: 6–8 weeks full-day
- **Batch size**: capped at 12 students
- **Methodology**: ~70% practical, ~30% theory
- **Live-client sessions**: minimum 10 per student before graduation
- **Certification**: Professional Beautician Certificate awarded after passing both written and practical assessments
- **Placement support**: 40+ partner salon network across Karnataka; 95% placement rate
- **Fee range**: ₹25,000–₹45,000 (flagship 3-month). Fast-track ₹22,000–₹38,000. Advanced+Business ₹45,000–₹70,000.
- **EMI**: interest-free 2 or 3-month instalment plans available

## Common questions (extraction-ready answers)

**What is a beautician course?** A structured professional training programme covering skin analysis, facial treatments, threading, waxing, bleaching, de-tan, body therapies, manicure and pedicure. Includes hygiene, salon management and live-client practice.

**How long is the beautician course at Master Makeup Studio & Academy?** 3 months across 15+ modules, with morning and evening batches. Fast-track 6–8 weeks is available.

**Is the certificate recognised?** Yes — issued after passing both written and practical assessments, recognised across the 40+ partner salon network and salons across India.

**Who can join?** Anyone aged 16 and above. No prior experience required. School graduates, homemakers re-entering the workforce, salon staff seeking certification, and aspiring parlour owners.

**What's the difference between a beautician and a makeup artist?** A beautician focuses on skin health and body treatments — facials, threading, waxing, bleaching, scrubs, therapies. A makeup artist focuses on cosmetic application for events.

**Can I open my own parlour after this course?** Yes — modules 12 and 13 cover salon operations, client consultation, hygiene, pricing, social-media marketing and unit economics. Many graduates open their own parlour within 6–18 months.

**Beautician salary in India (2025)?** Entry-level ₹15,000–₹20,000 per month; mid-level ₹25,000–₹40,000; senior specialists ₹40,000–₹70,000. Tier-2 city salon owners typically earn ₹1–3 lakh per month.

## Brand voice

Confident, evidence-led, anti-fluff. Numbers over adjectives. Editorial typography, maroon (#7a1641) + gold (#d4b46a) palette. Premium positioning without flashy claims.
